sections.title: Investment Recommendation
sections.text: Costco’s business model shows durable high‑volume, low‑margin strength, supported by strong free cash flow and a robust return on equity [[COST.ratio.return_on_average_equity]]. The low debt‑to‑equity ratio [[COST.ratio.debt_to_equity]] adds financial flexibility. Execution risk around expansion and cyber‑security concerns are noted, but the overall risk‑adjusted profile remains favorable.

insight.text: Low debt relative to equity provides financial flexibility
